For everyone who loved "Emma" and "Sense & Sensibility" comes the comedy Jane Austen loved best.

Where do you hide when the dark is alive?

Joe was once a good man.

Whatever side you take, you're wrong.

Can they really live a normal life after porn?

This firm will blow you away.

His first time in jails interrupts his music career, but after being released he starts his own band; Hurriganes.

Livin’ in my house! Lovin’ another man! Is that what you call bein’ honest? That’s just givin’ it a nice name!

15462: Sam Roberts thinks he has all the answers: the purpose of life, the meaning of love, the plan for a perfect future. Until Charly walks into his life.

RECKLESS with WOMEN...He pursued them ..."petted" them...promised them nothing and got away with everything!

The fall of an empire will be the rise of another.

Her passion was cooking, her obsession was deadly

A single night. A million possibilities. One connection.

You've never seen a honeymoon like this

23654: A robotics engineer searching for his perfect partner finds himself falling in love with a human-like android.

Everything was normal in their life until a sudden turn of events smashes Dan and Shiuli's lives together, into a bond.

26982: When two siblings stumble on a strange hole in the wall of their grandparents' house, horrifying incidents reveal sinister secrets about their family.
A truth you've never known, that makes you doubt what you know.

For whom sails to a new life...

Carry On laughing until you have hysterics, but... Don't Lose Your Head!
Sir Rodney Ffing, the Black Fingernail

Dead or Alive, They're Coming for Steve.

The most romantic ghost you've ever seen!

It's a RIOT how Cary carries on!
34662: In New York City, a bank robbery of $300,000 goes unsolved for a year, until some of the marked bills are found in a Los Angeles drugstore theft. Male Performer (segment "Rebirth") / Gloved Hand (segment "Right Brain / Martyrdom")
Businessman (segment "Right Brain / Martyrdom") / Doppelganger (segment "Right Brain / Martyrdom")

An assault, a new bed and some white curtains bring the two of them together.

Two soldiers of fortune matching wits and guns against the armies of two nations!
37222: Set in the aftermath of an oppressive class war, a pregnant officer aboard an escape pod must struggle to survive with her remaining crew when a mysterious and vicious life form attacks, determined to become the dominant species.

Tyrone Power -- Leading a reckless crew on the war's most daring mission!

The guy with the dynamite heart meets the girl with the firecracker eyes!

They're on the road to somewhere

Jacques Panivaux, Owner of the Rolls-Royce
Commissioner Rocheteau, Tracking Gaulard on the Run
Gustave, from the Tomato Coulis Farm

Believing in family can create miracles.

Getting ahead never felt so good.

By 2 a.m., I hope I'm naked with her!

love is intense, very sad and big.
